stories.title: Antonelli becomes world champion as Verstappen wins in Mexico
stories.brief: Kimi Antonelli becomes the youngest world champion in Formula 1 history as Max Verstappen wins the Mexico City Grand Prix.

stories.title: Drone-based smoke monitoring fails
stories.brief: Air pollution is increasing due to smoke-emitting vehicles, heavy black smoke from railway engines, factories and industrial units, the burning of scrap and garbage, and particularly emissions from brick kilns and stone-crushing plants.

stories.title: Petrol pricing revised to shield consumers
stories.brief: The federal government has revised the petrol pricing mechanism, directing refineries to surrender the difference between import and ex-refinery prices as petroleum levy, with the resulting benefit to be passed on to consumers through a corresponding reduction in petrol prices.

stories.title: FCC reasserts its status as apex court
stories.brief: A three-member bench led by Justice Farooq while hearing a review petition also said that Supreme Court jurisprudence evolved for leave to appeal from the decisions/orders of the high court under Article 199 of the Constitution is also not binding on it.

stories.title: China pushes Pakistan ties beyond government
stories.brief: A senior Chinese Communist Party official responsible for managing the party's international political relations arrived in Islamabad on Sunday for his first official visit to Pakistan. Liu Haixing, minister of the International Department of the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee, is visiting Pakistan at the invitation of Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar.

stories.title: K-P council faces operational delays
stories.brief: The Area Representatives and Development Council (ARDC), established for 12 districts of Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa (K-P), has yet to become fully operational more than two weeks after its formation, with its secretariat and offices still not functioning.

stories.title: Kimi Antonelli becomes Formula One’s youngest world champion in Mexico City
stories.brief: Italian wonderkid wins drivers' championship at 20 years and 68 days, finishing third at the Mexico City Grand Prix.

stories.title: Binance users withdraw $3.6bn after record crypto hack
stories.brief: The exchange froze transactions in the wake of the incident, which impacted $6.3bn worth of digital assets.

stories.title: Trump invites Michigan Democrat Stevens to join the Republican Party
stories.brief: US President Donald Trump praised Michigan Democrat Haley Stevens for endorsing Republican Mike Rogers.

stories.title: Don't get caught out by new Buy Now Pay Later rules
stories.brief: New affordability checks mean you could be blocked from using Buy Now Pay Later but here are ways to avoid it.

stories.title: Democrat Haley Stevens heckled as she backs El-Sayed rival
stories.brief: US Democrat Haley Stevens from Michigan was heckled as a ‘traitor’, after endorsing Republican Mike Rogers.

stories.title: National Grid to site biggest substation in UK near planned Teesside datacentre
stories.brief: The deal was first reported by Sky News.

stories.title: New York City Marathon: Sweden's Almgren and Kenya's Chepkirui win as 60,000 take part
stories.brief: Andreas Almgren of Sweden won the men's race of the New York City Marathon in his debut in the event while Sheila Chepkirui of Kenya won the women's race on Sunday for the second time.(Image credit: Angelina Katsanis)

stories.title: New York City Marathon: Andreas Almgren wins on debut as Sheila Chepkirui reclaims crown
stories.brief: He pulled away from Yemaneberhan Crippa of Italy in the final mile to take the victory in two hours, six minutes and one second. Kamohelo Mofolo of Lesotho was third, edging out defending champion Benson Kipruto.

stories.title: Hemp strikes back as Manchester City edge out London City Lionesses in thriller
stories.brief: Goals from Khadija Shaw and Lauren Hemp helped Manchester City to escape from Bromley with three points after a thrilling encounter with London City Lionesses. But that London City had even played their way into conversations about this season’s title contenders in their second season has been impressive.

stories.title: Crypto firm Binance covers 90% of losses after $6.3bn hack
stories.brief: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) says North Korea was responsible for the hack.

stories.title: The US-China trade war seems to have subsided – but the sense of calm is misleading
stories.brief: A truce has cooled the trade conflict, but neither country has done anything to limit the outbreak of new hostilitiesDonald Trump’s trade wars have largely fallen off the headlines.

stories.title: Shops looted as German cost-of-living protests turn violent
stories.brief: The protests in cities across Germany - including Berlin, Hamburg and Frankfurt - came on the same day hundreds of thousands also protested in France.

stories.title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'
stories.brief: The popular attraction in County Down has been forced to close while efforts continue to remove oil from the pond.
